summary: Wholesale price display verified working once admin pricing is configured. Temporary pricing (pengecer 3%, reseller 5%, qty ≥6→2%, ≥12→4%) was saved via Admin → Pengaturan Harga UI (persisted after reload). Guest + demo@pgs.id: home/search cards show price-range 'RpX - RpY' (e.g. Rp194.256 - Rp213.000), hemat badge shows, product detail shows Harga Grosir table (1-5 —/Rp213.000, 6-11 2%/Rp208.740, 12+ 4%/Rp204.480); tapping a row updates unit price. Marketplace seller product (TEST_ product by acct1) shows flat price, no range, no table. Fixed teardown verified: after running test_pgs_iter2.py the temporary pricing was still intact (not zeroed); ui_helper 'pricing'→'reset' left pricing exactly as before (tested with distinct values 1/2/7%, ≥10→3%). BUT ui_helper 'pricing' and test_pgs_iter2 TestPricing use legacy payload {min_qty, discount_percent} which backend now rejects with 422, so they silently/explicitly fail to apply test pricing. Final state restored and verified EQUAL to session start (all 0, percent, qty_tiers []), demo customer_type=langsung, 0 products with tier_prices, popular pins intact on 3 branches.

minor.issue: Sends qty_tiers [{min_qty, discount_percent}] → PUT /api/admin/pricing returns 422 (QtyTier requires 'value'); response not checked, so the 'pricing' command silently does NOT apply the test pricing (only sets demo to reseller).

5/20 fail due to stale assertions, not app bugs: TestPricing::test_global_pricing_reseller (same legacy discount_percent payload → 422), test_manual_tiers_override_reseller_only (cascade: demo not reseller), test_gateway_503[midtrans/xendit] (backend now returns 400 'Pembayaran online belum aktif...'), test_cod_and_admin_flow (expects +25000 shipping, now 0 → order left in 'cod' status; I cancelled my own PGS-261108-407E4B). Restore logic itself works.

Backup file /tmp/pgs_pricing_backup.json is never removed after 'reset' and is overwritten if 'pricing' runs twice (second run would back up the test values). Suggest refusing to overwrite an existing backup and deleting it after reset.

issues: Range min is the cheapest price across ALL customer types (reseller 12+ = Rp194.256), while a guest/langsung buyer's own table bottoms at Rp204.480. Can confuse buyers ('Rentang harga Rp194.256' unreachable for them). Confirm this is the intended 'termurah–termahal'.

After adding one qty tier, 'Tambah aturan jumlah' button sits under the fixed bottom 'Simpan' bar at 375x667; it must be scrolled into view first (paddingBottom 120 covers it only after scrolling). Minor.
